title: What should you eat before a workout? 🍽️
caption:
2-3 hours before: a normal meal with carbs, protein and a little fat. An hour or less: something small and easy, like a banana, toast, yogurt or a shake. Keep fat and fiber low right before training. What is your go-to pre-workout meal? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Diet & Food #7
